name: Brand Architekts Group plc
summary: Brand Architekts Group plc develops, formulates, and supplies personal care and beauty products in the United Kingdom, rest of European countries, and internationally. The company offers skincare products, haircare products, body care products, bathing products, men's products, and gifting products, as well as accessories under the Super Facialist, Dr SALTS+, Dirty Works, Kind Natured, Fish Soho, MR. Jamie Stevens, Quick Fix Facials, The Real Shaving Co., Argan 5, Senspa, and Happy Naturals brands. It serves consumers and retailers. The company was formerly known as Swallowfield plc and changed its name to Brand Architekts Group plc in August 2019. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Teddington, the United Kingdom.
